title: Display both an AI reviewer and its human principal
preconditions: A review is open at a committed head; a named AI reviewer acts on behalf of an identified human whose Git identity is configured.

steps.action: Record an AI decision with distinct reviewer name, agent and model, then commit as the human principal.
steps.expected_result: The action records the AI identity and remains attributable to the principal.

steps.action: Read the decision label and its provenance.
steps.expected_result: Both the AI and the human principal are identifiable.

expected_result: Both the AI and the human principal are identifiable.
